bagPolicy.summary: Howard Theatre does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The venue recommends reserving nearby parking in advance; additional parking is available at Progression Place, 1825 7th Street NW. The Shaw–Howard University Metro station is about one block away.

rideshare.note: Ride share services such as Uber/Lyft are easily available from the metro stop.

concessions.note: The Howard Theatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic American fare and a selection of beverages. Patrons can enjoy a mix of casual dining and quick bites, with options to suit different tastes. Special offerings may include themed cocktails or seasonal menu items.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Howard Theatre, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Howard Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Howard Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Howard Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
